long_biography.plain_text:
At Cadena Capriles, Miguel Ángel Capriles López combined family ownership with an unusually informal management style. Colleagues could approach him directly; he ate in the company canteen and joined staff sporting and cultural events. The Caracas-trained business administrator became chairman and chief executive after his father's death and guided the newspaper group through a generational transition.

His tenure brought new editorial models and a shift from print-only routines towards multimedia production. The group developed web editions and a live news portal while retaining newspapers for general, financial and sporting audiences. Capriles also introduced technology that unified administrative and editorial processes across the organisation, before confirming the sale of its companies, brands and assets in 2013.
